detect_filter.label: Detect-and-filter
detect_filter.assumes: an adversary exists and is detectable at the boundary

structural_separation.label: Structural separation
structural_separation.assumes: data and instructions can be kept in separate channels

context_management.label: Context management
context_management.assumes: content is abundant, not hostile; no adversary is modelled

instruction_integrity.label: Instruction integrity
instruction_integrity.assumes: the user's task is known and deviation from it is observable

belief_arbitration.label: Belief arbitration
belief_arbitration.assumes: conflict is accidental, so trust between sources can be re-weighted

memory_architecture.label: Memory architecture
memory_architecture.assumes: memory degrades on its own; it is not planted

capability_control.label: Capability control
capability_control.assumes: containment beats detection; assume some payload gets through

note: family is decided by the defense's own name and notes. Track and intervention point are reported, never used to decide. Entries a human must still rule on are in `ambiguous` and `unassigned`.
